projectDescription: A security research CLI tool by watchTowr Labs that detects and demonstrates CVE-2026-41940, a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in cPanel/WHM that enables unauthenticated root-level access.
keyFeatures: Four-stage authentication bypass exploit chain targeting cPanel/WHM
Automatic canonical hostname discovery via cpsrvd 307 redirect
CRLF injection via Basic Authorization header to forge session data
WHM security token extraction from leaked Location headers
Root-level WHM API access verification via /json-api/version
SSL verification bypass for self-signed certificates
publicApiSurface: --hostname: Override Host header (optional, auto-discovered if omitted)
stage1_preauth(): Mints a pre-auth WHM session and extracts session base token
stage2_inject(): Sends CRLF injection with Basic auth to leak cp_security_token
stage3_propagate(): Fires do_token_denied to propagate raw session to cache
stage4_verify(): Verifies root-level WHM access via JSON API version endpoint
call_whm_api(): Authenticated WHM JSON API caller using bypassed session
discover_canonical_host(): Auto-discovers correct hostname from cpsrvd redirect
parse_target(): Parses scheme, host, and port from target URL
